text:
The Community Nurse Head
Care Well Hospital
Birmingham

31 December, 2017

Dear Sir/ Madam,

Re:  Mr Alfred Billy, aged 52

I am writing to refer Mr Alfred, who was diagnosed with skin cancer on his neck. After recovering from his operation, he is now ready to be discharged and requires your assistance and support for home care.

During the stay at our hospital, Mr Alfred had skin biopsy done, which showed two types of skin cancer, basal cell carcinoma and nodular basal-cell carcinoma. Following the removal surgery, he has been placed on 500mg of Panadein Forte for surgical pain, with good effect. He has made good progress since.

In terms of Mr Alfred’s social history, he is a truck driver with habits of drinking and smoking. He lives with his wife, Maria Jennifer, who is also his emergency contact. 

Please note that Mr Alfred will need to take his pain medication for one more week after his discharge. Also, his observations need to be taken daily. 

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,
XXX
RN

Writing Task
You are the charge nurse on the hospital ward where Mr. Alfred Billy has recently had his
operation. Using the information provided in the case notes, write a referral letter to the Community Nurse Head at Care Well Hospital, Birmingham, who will be attending to Mr. Alfred Billy, following his discharge.
In your answer:
Expand the relevant case notes into complete sentences.
Do not use note form.
The body of the letter should be approximately 200 words.
Use correct letter format.
